FAQ

Practical questions

Can you organise an event outside Tbilisi?

Yes. We can build programmes across Georgia, including countryside locations and Kakheti. Scope depends on dates, travel and the format.

Can you find and inspect venues for us?

Yes. We can shortlist suitable spaces, visit them, check practical details and handle the local conversation.

Can you coordinate all local suppliers?

Yes. Supplier sourcing, briefs, timings and event-day coordination can sit within one production plan.

Can you organise wine tastings or trips to Kakheti?

Yes. We can create private tastings, sommelier-led formats, winery visits and food-and-wine programmes.

Can you produce branded merchandise for the event?

Yes. We can integrate gifts, textiles, print, signage and welcome packs into the event concept.

Can you support an international company with no local team in Georgia?

That is a core use case. We become your local point of contact and represent the project on the ground.

How early should we start planning?

For a straightforward event, four to eight weeks is a useful starting point. Larger or multi-day formats benefit from more time.
